create.name: Tias Little
create.bio:
Tias Little is a yoga and meditation teacher who, together with his wife Surya Little, runs the Prajna Yoga school in Santa Fe, New Mexico. He started studying Iyengar yoga in 1984, and in 1989 went to Mysore to practise Ashtanga with Pattabhi Jois. Alongside asana he has long practised Buddhist meditation, starting with Vipassana and later Tibetan Buddhism and Zen, and he completed a master's in Eastern philosophy at St. John's College. His background also takes in bodywork and somatic study.

His classes join careful alignment with meditation, breath, the subtle body and an unusually literary voice: he often reads poetry in class and writes his own. He developed SATYA (Sensory Awareness Training for Yoga Attunement), a slow, floor-based practice of small gliding movements meant to sharpen inner sensing, which he teaches as a companion to postures. Prajna Yoga offers 200, 300 and 500-hour teacher trainings, SATYA immersions held in Santa Fe and by livestream, and online classes. His books include The Practice is the Path, Yoga of the Subtle Body, Meditations on a Dewdrop and the poetry collection In the Space Between.

books.title: The Practice is the Path
books.author: Tias Little
books.description: Short chapters drawn from more than thirty years of practice, in which he reflects on yoga and Buddhist teaching as a lifelong spiritual path. It mixes personal stories with practical guidance for anyone committed to a body-based discipline.

books.title: In the Space Between: The Poetry of Embodiment
books.author: Tias Little
books.description: His first collection of poems and short prose, written to be read aloud during meditation or at the end of a yoga class. The pieces explore sensation, language and the quiet inner spaces that practice opens.

courses.title: Yoga Nidra: A Somatic Approach to Deep Rest | Online Training
courses.description: A live online training over three pairs of dates in November and December, in which gentle somatic movement prepares the body for guided yoga nidra. All Zoom sessions are recorded.

courses.title: SATYA 1 | Opening the Fascia | In-Person & Livestream Online Immersion
courses.description: A five-day introduction to SATYA, his slow floor-based practice of sliding and circling movements done without force to build inner sensing. It is held in Santa Fe and also by livestream, and suits first-time and returning students.

courses.title: Prajna Yoga Teacher Certification (200, 300 and 500 hour)
courses.description: Teacher trainings that weave together asana, yoga anatomy and wisdom study, from a 200-hour foundation course to advanced 300 and 500-hour programmes including meditation and SATYA. Entry is by application.

courses.title: Prajna Yoga online class library
courses.description: Recorded online classes and short courses from Tias and Surya Little, grouped by area of the body, breath, restorative practice and SATYA, for practice at home.
